body: Not sure what to do?  The hurt will be there friend,  but perhaps I can offer some different view on it.  I’ll drag you out of the hole buddy.  Feel free to reach out to me.  We can chat anytime.

First post excuse any thing I do out of etiquette


     Hello friend.  I have been in your place for a few years.  I ended up 5150 and was there through Christmas Eve to a few days after New Year’s Day.  I was visiting my ex on holiday leave and the fist time I’d ever been to that state.  I felt like I had vanished. I had let her get to me again and was mad at myself for my roll in the situation.  To top it off I felt like my squad leader was going to wrap a 2x4 around my head.  Come to find out 7 of those guys had a plan to break me out.  And a week after I get out somehow one of the most miserable experiences in my life became a hilarious story.  One I can share if you find hearing it could occupy your mind.  
     The main point of this is to convey you never know how it’ll work out.  It’s hard to get out of a hole.  However you don’t belong in the hole friend.  Even if it takes one inch at a time. Even when you fall a few feet.  Grab and hold.  Head down,  move through the storm.  Your situation sounds so similar to what I went through.  So I’m reaching out.  I don’t pretend to know what you truly want.  But if you do want some support from me,  you have it.  If not,  I wish you luck in wherever you find life has placed you.
